name: Still Yours
tagline: You liked it first. You get to like it last.
epigraph: It was made for the staff. It didn't stay there.
glassware: a saucer coupe (a wide, shallow stemmed glass), chilled
language_row: Wren's Resonance below: 0 generic sentences; sibling echoes swapped out (Overnight's "what nobody sees", The Other Berry's "what you can't stand" / "what you give people", Four Shares' "You're allowed to"); Off-Label's "Go back to it" and "the way he tells it" rewritten; the closing line moved off The Other Berry's "don't apologise"; pronouns in yours 1–4 are all Cecchini (accepted by Wren); "shrill" is his word, dated, secondary tier; never "cool". ✓
sources: Studio fact card `_studio/fact-cards/cosmopolitan-toby-cecchini.md` (*A Proper Drink* pp. 42–44; *Oxford Companion* COSMOPOLITAN pdf 585; Alice Lascelles, *Elite Traveler*, secondary). Craft: *Cocktail Codex* (Sidecar family, daisy, pp. 106, 183–184); *Flavor Matrix* (berries × basil, pdf 52; kiwi, pdf 156). Set aside: `fact-cards/sasha-petraske-fifty-fifty.md`, `fact-cards/del-maguey-oaxaca-old-fashioned.md`. Room notes: `work/creator-outlaw/`.
names_note: **Still Yours**, the room's pick (Wren; Tomás and Hester back it). Also considered: *Out Loud* (Tomás; "out loud" is in two sibling readings), *Staff Drink* (Wren), *Shrill* (dropped: an insult said about a guest).
open_items: **Sugar edge:** 7.82 g before dilution against the 8.0 g floor (5.11 g finished), justified in Checks as his stated taste ("shrill", F19). The recipe holds only with a 40% orange liqueur (30% drops it to 14.6%, under the strength floor) and the sweetened cranberry juice cocktail, not "light" (4.78 g, under the sugar floor).
**Unsourced values (balance.py):** citrus vodka (lemon-flavoured, unsweetened, Absolut Citron style) and cranberry juice cocktail (sweetened, ~27% juice) use table estimates, not a sourced label.

**Secondary source in the present tense:** y3's "Last I read, in 2026, he still makes it at his own bar in Brooklyn … 'shrill'" rests on Alice Lascelles, *Elite Traveler* (secondary, named writer). Robin's call whether that tier is enough.
**Basil wording is Tomás's inference:** "leaving their scent and a little of their taste" (the hard shake bruises the leaves); the numbers are unchanged by it.

**Sibling note:** cranberry also appears in *Rosetta* (a homemade syrup under absinthe); here it's the sweetened juice cocktail the Odeon kept for Cape Codders. The Cosmopolitan card was *Overnight*'s runner-up, set aside there for *Half a Rim*'s shape and *Rosetta*'s cranberry; this room judged it the right story here.
**Wren's first cut if Robin frowns:** whoYouAre's opening, "You rarely set out to start anything."

**Runner-up:** Sasha Petraske's 50-50 Martini (dropped: OUT on sugar and acid, a third Martini next to *Quite Alive*, and no record of him choosing to keep the drink). Library gap named by Hester: Petraske's own *Regarding Cocktails* (Phaidon, 2016).
**Also set aside:** Phil Ward's Oaxaca Old-Fashioned (no moment on record of choosing to keep or leave it).
